answer: Rule: a new identity starts with zero power. Power accrues only from settled grades that match the final verdict: one aligned grade earns one point, one divergent grade wipes the identity's points. Twenty points over five epochs unlock full weight. One fake costs twenty accurate grades and five epochs of patient work; ten fakes need two hundred aligned grades, and one bad grade on any of them resets it to zero. Like shale strata, each ridge of fake power must be climbed separately, and the canyon between a fresh identity and real influence is time no money can bridge.
